release_notes:
🚀 v0.1.2 Stream Stabilization, Download Probing & Fallback Hardening
• Accurate Download Sizing & CDN Headers: HTTP HEAD/Range 0-0 file size probing with automatic CDN auth header forwarding
• 403 Infinite Loop Resolution: Bounded retry engine with failedServers tracking and graceful source/extension fallback
• Stale CDN Token Firewall: Discards expired Vidlink stream URLs (t < unix_timestamp) to prevent short-circuiting valid fallbacks
• Anime Episode Resolution: Fixed episode 1 lock bug for all series selections
• Anime TV Season Fallback: Guarded season switching against false-positive standalone movie fallbacks (Bleach, One Piece)
• Stream Security: Hardened Provider J against rogue adult video contamination
